algorithm_policy.primary: grow free shapes one edge-neighbor at a time; normalize every extension under translation, rotation, and reflection; retain one lexicographically canonical signature per size
algorithm_policy.symmetry_group: the eight rotations/reflections of the square (D4)
algorithm_policy.independent_reference: restricted fixed-shape growth in Redelmeier's half-plane followed by D4 canonicalization
algorithm_policy.complexity: for layer sizes k=1..n-1, at most S_k<=512 shapes produce 4*k candidates each; each candidate canonicalization costs O(8*k^2) and linear-list deduplication costs O(S_(k+1)*k), so primary time is O(sum_k 4*k*S_k*(8*k^2+S_(k+1)*k)) and state space is O(2*512*n) coordinate words
algorithm_policy.independent_reference_complexity: restricted fixed-shape growth visits each fixed shape at most once per size; with conservative O(n^2) copied blocked/frontier bookkeeping per visit and O(8*n*log(n)) final symmetry normalization, time is O(n^2*sum_k F_k + 8*n*log(n)*F_n), where F_k is the fixed-shape count; recursive copies use O(n^3) space plus stored free signatures

output.encoding: number of free n-ominoes, where translations, rotations, and reflections are identified

source.reuse: task titles identify the subject only; algorithm descriptions are paraphrased, and no source code, task text, examples, or tests are copied
